page.overview:
Who is Vanek?

Vanek was a Human Starfleet enlisted crewman who served as yeoman to Admiral Simon Reeger in the mid-23rd century.

In 2262, Vanek and Reeger were en route to a conference at Starbase 1 when their shuttle chanced upon a gamma ray trail left by the vessel responsible for the Vaardan massacre. She subsequently accompanied him to the , and stood witness as he commandeered the starship and almost enacted General Order 24 on Argus II in an attempt to destroy the unknown enemy. ()
